title: Sky
caption: The theme selects the light; clouds carry the wind
intro: Switch the site theme to compare the sun and crescent moon. The second specimen forces a moon independently of the surrounding theme. The clouds show the default Surface arrangement in three layers.
contract: Import SunMoon from slide-shared/iceberg/scenery/sun-moon and Clouds from scenery/clouds. Both lights are server-rendered and CSS selects day or night. Cloud placements accept x, y, scale, shape and a layer (far, mid or near); without one, the size picks it. Each layer drifts at its own speed: the Surface's wind, which the gallery pause control also stops. ZoneScene draws the flat sky, its night stars and the lit waterline around them.

variants.theme: Sun or moon, selected by the site theme
variants.clouds: Surface clouds, drifting in the wind
